contents: Venue master: target venue (V01) plus 12 similar stadiums
Pairwise venue similarity (capacity, roof, climate) with rank; ≥12 similar venues per venue
Six zones per venue with people capacity and coordinates
Cells/sectors per venue: site, sector, band, technology, zone mapping
UL/DL capacity and PRB count per cell over time (2019, 2021, 2024 upgrades)
Neighbor relations with overlap, typical event headroom and steering eligibility
Daily weather per venue city
All past events: football (home vs away watch party), concerts, rallies, other; expected vs actual attendance; COVID cancellations
Today's live event plus all scheduled events in the next 30 days
Context per event: home/away multiplier, win %, social interest, search trend, transit/road advisories, competing events
Top 12 most similar historical events (across similar venues) for every target-venue event since 2022 and all upcoming ones
Per-cell hourly KPIs for every completed event, 6 h before to 6 h after start
Per-cell daily baseline KPIs for every day (event and non-event)
15-second per-cell telemetry for target-venue events in the last 12 months, with congestion flag and 60/120/180-s labels
Live 15-second stream for today's in-progress event with forecast, residual and predicted risk
Live error/drift monitoring per cell: rolling MAE, bias, RMSE, drift score and alert
Backtest record: forecast (issued 7 days ahead) vs actual peak PRB, users and attendance by model version
Daily rolling MAPE, bias, interval coverage and PSI drift with drift flags (COVID, C-band upgrade)
Hourly per-cell forecasts with intervals and 60/120/180-s risk for upcoming events
Decision audit: recommendation, neighbor target, approval, simulated outcome, verify result, fallback/escalation
Congestion rule versions (placeholder, not approved)
Backhaul link inventory: one link per cell site plus one aggregation link per venue
Backhaul capacity changes (baseline + upgrades)
Backhaul load, headroom, latency and loss for every event hour, all venues
Backhaul load every 15 s for the target venue, last 12 months + live event
Backhaul-aware check for every steer/fallback decision: radio + transport headroom, verdict, tier
Accessibility, session/VoLTE drop rates and uplink packet loss per cell per event hour
Temporary capacity (COWs, small cells) per event: cost, crew hours, whether needed, and what the PoC would have done
Engineer minutes per decision: manual process vs PoC review, detection lag vs lead
Crowds not on any schedule (celebrations, marches, protests, parades, evacuations) with warning sources and impact
15-second uplink telemetry for every unplanned gathering at the target venue
Uplink and downlink volume split by application group per venue per event hour
Device mix per event (5G SA/NSA, LTE, wearables) and uplink-capable features
Exact network settings changed for each steer/fallback, with revert and change ticket
Digital-twin comparison for each decision: no action vs with action on P10, congestion, drops, accessibility
